meta.title: 太喜欢海边了！！
meta.title_en: I Love the Seaside So Much!!
meta.topic: 拍照姿势 · 海边出片

scenes.context: 海边站姿：手指天空配合扭腰，营造 S 型身体曲线。语域：拍照教学，海边场景。
sentences: 站姿：手指天空，配合扭腰。
Point at the sky while twisting the waist.
营造 S 型身体曲线。
The seaside light is just right.
paraphrase: 扭腰 → twist the waist / pivot the hips
twist the waist · pivot the hips
S型曲线 → S-curve silhouette / an S line
scenes.speak: Point at the sky while twisting the waist. It shapes an S-curve silhouette. The seaside light is just right.

scenes.context: 海边坐姿：坐直+扭身+比心，三要素营造自然互动感。语域：拍照教学，坐姿技巧。
sentences: Seated: sit straight, twist, and make a heart.
Three elements create an interactive feel.
The frame feels natural and alive.
paraphrase: 比心 → make a heart / a heart sign
make a heart · a heart sign
scenes.speak: Seated: sit straight, twist, and make a heart. Three elements create an interactive feel. The frame feels natural and alive.

scenes.context: 人物右下角构图：扭腰同时看向海面，利用留白制造氛围感。语域：拍照教学，构图技巧。
sentences: Place the subject in the lower-right of the frame.
Twist the waist and look toward the sea.
look toward the sea（看向海面）
paraphrase: 留白 → negative space / empty space
scenes.speak: Place the subject in the lower-right of the frame. Twist the waist and look toward the sea. Use negative space for atmosphere.

scenes.context: 交叉腿坐姿：手部完全放松，头部自然转向右侧。最后一个收尾姿势。语域：拍照教学，收尾。
sentences: Cross the legs and keep the hands relaxed.
keep the hands relaxed（手部放松）
Turn the head naturally to the right.
a perfect closing pose（完美收尾）
paraphrase: 交叉腿 → cross the legs / legs crossed
收尾 → closing pose / the final shot
scenes.speak: Cross the legs and keep the hands relaxed. Turn the head naturally to the right. It's a perfect closing pose.

practice: Point at the sky while twisting the waist.
Sit straight, twist, and make a heart.
Cross the legs and keep the hands relaxed.
pitfalls: Point at the sky while twisting the waist.
「扭腰」用 twist the waist，造 S 型曲线。
Place the subject in the lower-right of the frame.
「右下角构图」用 lower-right of the frame。
「留白」用 negative space，不是填满画面。
Cross the legs and keep the hands relaxed.
「手部放松」用 keep the hands relaxed。
shifts: 用 seaside light（海边光线）、S-curve silhouette（S型曲线）、look toward the sea（看向海面）
用 framing（构图）、negative space（留白）、lower-right of the frame（右下角）
用 make a heart（比心）、cross the legs（交叉腿）、interactive feel（互动感）
footer_notes: 本视频无口播转录，场景数据基于图文实录图片说明（figcaption）重建。已校正：手指天空、扭腰、S型身体曲线、坐直扭身比心、三要素互动感、右下角构图、看向海面、留白氛围、交叉腿坐姿、手部放松等。
